description: Office interior design and custom furniture in Bratislava and Vienna by DUMSKAYA DESIGN. 53 m² office project with bespoke furniture, turnkey renovation, photorealistic 3D visualization and photos of the completed commercial interior.
h1: Office Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 53 m²

blocks.text: Office Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 53 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed and completed a 53 m² office interior project, including interior design, custom furniture manufacturing, and turnkey renovation.

The project focused on functional workspace planning, ergonomics, and contemporary aesthetics. Custom office furniture was designed together with the interior, allowing efficient use of the available space and creating a cohesive working environment.
The page features photorealistic 3D visualizations and photographs of the completed office, demonstrating how the original design concept was implemented in the finished interior.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides commercial interior design, custom furniture design and manufacturing, and turnkey implementation for offices, retail stores, boutiques, and beauty salons in Bratislava and Vienna.
